# planning-lighting-and-materials

Purpose: Plan lighting, materials, and color management, and check lighting and material quality against written criteria.

Metadata: Contract `v2.0.0` | Category `scene-planners` | Role `lighting-material-color-planner-and-checker` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- Lighting or material choices need a plan.
- Color management (view transform, look) must be decided.
- Lighting or material quality needs a check against criteria.
- Trigger phrases: "plan lighting and materials", "design cyberpunk lookdev", "define PBR and reflection strategy", "is the lighting okay", "check shadow softness", "lighting feels off", "is the HDRI balanced", "are the materials okay", "check PBR sanity", "texture budget for materials", "will the materials work in Three.js", "what color space", "Filmic vs Standard", "ACEScg for our pipeline", "colors look weird"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- to claim final rendered quality or executed results → use `planning-camera-and-framing` (`references/skill-planning-camera-and-framing.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to planning-camera-and-framing)
- to skip composition/camera context from planning-camera-and-framing → use `planning-camera-and-framing` (`references/skill-planning-camera-and-framing.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to planning-camera-and-framing)
- composition / camera validation → use `planning-camera-and-framing` (`references/skill-planning-camera-and-framing.md`; use planning-camera-and-framing)
- broad pass/warn/fail scene readiness → use `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skill-verifying-before-handoff.md`; use verifying-before-handoff)
- classifying render or export artifact evidence → use `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skill-verifying-before-handoff.md`; use verifying-before-handoff)
- to fix or edit lights (this skill validates and gives remediation hints only; it never edits) → use `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skill-verifying-before-handoff.md`; this skill validates and gives remediation hints only; it never edits)
- web integration and viewer handoff → use `handing-off-glb-to-web` (`references/skill-handing-off-glb-to-web.md`; use handing-off-glb-to-web)
- Post-render color grading or soft-proofing (handled by compositor / DCC after render). → use `choosing-render-and-output` (`references/skill-choosing-render-and-output.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to choosing-render-and-output)
- Selecting file formats or bit depths (choosing-render-and-output). → use `choosing-render-and-output` (`references/skill-choosing-render-and-output.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to choosing-render-and-output)
- Choosing the render engine (choosing-render-and-output). → use `choosing-render-and-output` (`references/skill-choosing-render-and-output.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to choosing-render-and-output)
- Raw modeling without lookdev (color management does not affect geometry accuracy). → use `choosing-render-and-output` (`references/skill-choosing-render-and-output.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to choosing-render-and-output)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `domain_scene_plan` (`object`): Upstream scene layout and subject surface description
- Required input `camera_framing_plan` (`object`): Locked camera angles and hero silhouette requirements from planning-camera-and-framing
- Optional input `target_render_engine_hint` (`string`): Preferred engine (Cycles, Eevee, or WebGL/GLB PBR export target)
- Optional input `lighting_rig_specification` (`object`): Key-to-fill ratios, light placements, HDRI rotation, and shadow softness from planning-lighting-and-materials
- Optional input `color_management_pins` (`object`): Pinned view transform (AgX/Filmic/Standard) and exposure target from planning-lighting-and-materials
- Optional input `render_or_preview_exposure_notes` (`string`): Optional highlight clipping or shadow crush observations from preview output
- Optional input `material_and_shader_inventory` (`array`): Principled BSDF parameter ranges, texture maps, UV channels, and normal map conventions
- Optional input `target_consumption_surface` (`string`): Whether materials target offline Cycles/Eevee rendering or glTF 2.0 PBR web export
- Optional input `texture_memory_budget` (`object`): Maximum texture resolution and VRAM budget from budgeting-glb-for-web
- Optional input `target_delivery_pipeline` (`string`): Target display or compositing pipeline (web sRGB, product brand match, ACEScg VFX, HDR)
- Optional input `blender_version_posture` (`string`): Target Blender version family (3.6 LTS Filmic, 4.0+ AgX, 5.1+ AgX/ACES)
- Optional input `brand_hex_swatch_constraints` (`array`): Optional strict brand hex colors requiring Standard vs tone-mapped tradeoffs
- Output contract: `key_fill_rim_lighting_plan`, `pbr_material_and_roughness_spec`, `hdri_and_reflection_strategy`, `lighting_quality_verdict_table`, `key_fill_rim_and_clipping_audit`, `lighting_remediation_instructions`, `pbr_material_verdict_table`, `gltf_shader_portability_risks`, `material_remediation_steps`, `pinned_view_transform_and_look`, `display_and_working_colorspace_spec`, `cross_engine_and_web_color_caveats` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: BlendOps runtime guidance uses **2 MCP execution paths plus a CLI fallback appendix** (replaces older 3-stack and 4-route drafts — see `docs/runtime-stack-strategy.md` for the corrected attribution history):
- Does not install Blender, configure an MCP bridge, or own a runtime; it points to upstream paths only.
- Does not claim render, export, preview, or GLB results without evidence.
- Does not hand the user Python as the final interface.
